newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST-Spain money market rate down to 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Spain money market rate down to 6 pct.

text.p: Catalan parliamentary economic spokesman Francesc Homs on Wednesday said there was room for Spain's key money market rate to fall by a half-point in the next two months.
"We think the interest rate should drop by half-a-point during the next two months and that it will stand at around six percent," he told news agency Efe.
The Bank of Spain left its key rate unchanged at 6.75 percent earlier.
Homs said he understood the central bank's cautiousness, saying that it aimed to avoid a sudden rise in the deficit and inflation, an essential condition for further rate cuts.
For Homs, the evolution of wages was a key factor. He pointed out that the Bank of Spain had repeatedly asked for wage moderation recently.
